title: Practice forgiveness until fear loosens
summary: This meets resentment disguised as strength. The line makes forgiveness a discipline of conduct and contentment, not a soft feeling.
lifeApplication: When the wound starts speaking again, notice the jaw and stomach before the story hardens. Release one rehearsed sentence and let the body stop preparing for battle.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness, conduct, and contentment form the fast that frees the heart.
source.lifeApplication: When resentment rises, drop one sentence you keep feeding and stay with the breath.

evidence.coreClaim: Forgiveness, conduct, and contentment form the fast that frees the heart.
evidence.turn: Forgiveness, conduct, and contentment free the heart from fear.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the wound starts speaking again, notice the jaw and stomach before the story hardens. Release one rehearsed sentence and let the body stop preparing for battle.
